value.rationale: The primary paper explicitly leaves rigorous global attraction unanswered, and relies on an extra smallness condition for boundedness. This theorem removes it and settles all initial conditions and invasion regimes. At neutral predator invasion the equilibrium is nonhyperbolic: the exact physically motivated universal coefficients show interaction-feedback contributions from fear, refuge, crowding and self-interference and cannot be deduced from local hyperbolic stability alone.
